prompt:
We're building out the web UI for TaskFlow's Kanban board feature. The backend team has already created the Swift ViewModel files that define all the data the frontend will receive — you can find them in the Kanban folder under the ViewModels source directory.

We need two web template files created:

1. **TaskCardView.leaf** — A self-contained card component for a single task. It needs to work for partial-page (AJAX) updates where JavaScript will swap it into the DOM. JavaScript will need to read the task's ID, status, and priority off the element to build server requests. The status and priority should also be displayed to users in a readable format. If a task is overdue, show an overdue indicator. If the task has an assignee, show their name and initial; otherwise show the unassigned label from the ViewModel. Show the message count summary and the due/created dates. Important: the message count display should come from the single pre-formatted ViewModel property.

2. **KanbanBoardView.leaf** — The full Kanban board page. It should have a proper page title and a visible board heading. It renders a list of columns, and each column should embed the card component above for its tasks. If a column has no tasks, show the column's empty message. If the board itself has no columns at all, show the board-level empty message. Each column element must expose its status value so that the JavaScript drag-and-drop code (already written in main.js) can read it.

Please place both files where the Vapor web app will find them for the Kanban feature.
